title: Collatz · the 3n+1 map
statement:
theorem collatz_conjecture : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ m : ℕ, (fun k : ℕ => if Even k then k / 2 else 3 * k + 1)^[m] n = 1 := by
  sorry
question: yes-no
informal: Start from any positive integer; if it is even halve it, if it is odd triple it and add one. Does every start eventually reach 1?
direction: open either way: prove the statement (checked by computer far beyond any hand search, no proof known) or prove its negation (a start that never reaches 1: a diverging orbit or a cycle that avoids 1); both are accepted

formalConjectures.upstreamForm: def collatzStep (n : ℕ) : ℕ := if Even n then n / 2 else 3 * n + 1; theorem collatz_conjecture (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0) : ∃ m, collatzStep^[m] n = 1

/-- formal-conjectures' step function (FormalConjectures/Wikipedia/CollatzConjecture.lean). -/
def collatzStep (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if Even n then n / 2 else 3 * n + 1

/-- The statement's anonymous step is exactly that `collatzStep`, so the two forms of the statement are the same proposition. -/
theorem step_is_collatzStep : (fun k : ℕ => if Even k then k / 2 else 3 * k + 1) = collatzStep := rfl

/-- 27 reaches 1 after 111 steps (the standard check of the orbit of 27). -/
theorem collatz_27 : collatzStep^[111] 27 = 1 := by
  decide +kernel

/-- Positivity is preserved, so an orbit never leaves the positive integers. -/
theorem collatzStep_pos {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) : 0 < collatzStep n := by
  unfold collatzStep
  split_ifs with he
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := he
    omega
  · omega

theorem iterate_pos {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) : 0 < collatzStep^[k] n := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact collatzStep_pos ih

/-- The reduction to stopping times: if every n > 1 has some k with collatzStep^[k] n < n, then every positive n reaches 1. (Strong induction on n.) -/
theorem stopping_time_reduction
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 < n → ∃ k : ℕ, collatzStep^[k] n < n) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ m : ℕ, collatzStep^[m] n = 1 := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 n with h1 | h1
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h n h1
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ih _ hk (iterate_pos hn k)
      exact ⟨j + k, by rw [Function.iterate_add_apply]; exact hj⟩
    · have : n = 1 := by omega
      exact ⟨0, by simp [this]⟩
